context: A mom hears her young son recap school
purpose: Teach: そしたら/おまけに/ことし/おっしゃい/モテ/たいした/何かと/鮮やか

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ことし、僕、たいした失敗もなく、いい感じ!
lines.en: Mom, I've had a pretty good year—no big mistakes or anything!
lines.style: Bright, energetic delivery with pride underneath. Quick pace. Slight lift at the end like he's showing something he made. Natural child enthusiasm without performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 立派ね。何かとお手伝いもしてくれて、ママ嬉しいよ。
lines.en: That's wonderful. And you've been such a help to me too—Mom is really grateful.
lines.style: Warm approval, genuine. Soft smile in the voice. Slow, deliberate pace on the first sentence. Light, affirming tone that makes him feel seen, not just praised.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ケンくん、ナナちゃんに「鮮やかな絵だね」っておっしゃい出してた。
lines.en: Ken was telling Nana her drawing was really vivid.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation delivered with quiet delight. Slight lift on 'vivid'—he's noticed something and is sharing it like evidence. Small-voiced but clear.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ、彼、誰にでもモテそうな空気あるわね。
lines.en: He does have that way about him, doesn't he—the kind of person everyone seems to like.
lines.style: Amused, knowing recognition. Gentle laugh underneath. Conversational, thinking-aloud rhythm. Not mocking, but noticing something true with a hint of fondness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: そしたらね、ナナちゃんもニコッて笑ってた!
lines.en: And then Nana just lit up and smiled!
lines.style: Bright excitement bubbling over. Faster pace, slight breathiness on 'lit up'. The delight of witnessing something small and genuine between people. Innocent enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: おまけに、お友達のつながり、もっと深まるね。
lines.en: That's what friendships need—those little moments that bring people closer together.
lines.style: Reflective, tender finality. Slow, warm delivery. Slight trailing-off as if she's thinking aloud about something that matters. Voice settling like a conclusion. Motherly wisdom without preaching.
